Cloud limits

In the cloud, question names may only use letters, digits, _, ., and -, up to 100 characters. A request can include up to 4 images, each at most 4 MiB and 16 megapixels, 8 MiB in total. Input is limited to 65,536 tokens. Longer input is rejected, not truncated. Usage is billed per input token at the listed price.
